description: This Java source file defines the CreatePolicyResponse class, which is an immutable, JSON-serializable response object used in handling responses to CreatePolicy commands within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for constructing instances from parameters or JSON, as well as accessors and overrides for object equality and representation.

classes.name: CreatePolicyResponse
classes.description: Immutable response class for a CreatePolicy command, capable of serialization/deserialization with JSON, containing policy ID and optionally the created policy.

methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the created Policy, if available.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the created Policy as JSON if available, respecting schema version.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path for the resource, here an empty pointer.

methods.description: Appends the response payload to a JSON object builder based on schema version and predicate.

methods.description: Returns a new CreatePolicyResponse with updated Ditto headers.
